channel.title: The Grant Desk - Writers, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Writers, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: The Open Notebook Early-Career Fellowship 2027 (remote)
item.description: The Open Notebook · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 6,600 stipend over the twelve-month part-time fellowship, plus one-on-one mentoring from an experienced science journalist and published clips at The Open Notebook. No application fee.

item.title: J. Anthony Lukas Work-in-Progress Awards 2027
item.description: Columbia Journalism School and the Nieman Foundation · deadline 03 Dec 2026 · Two awards of USD 25,000 each. No entry fee for the Work-in-Progress awards.

item.title: La Scam: Bourses Brouillon d'un reve Sonore (Radio and Podcast Authors, rolling)
item.description: La Scam (Societe civile des auteurs multimedia) · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 2,500 to EUR 6,000 per bourse, paid directly to the author 4 to 5 weeks after contract signing; over EUR 830,000 is distributed annually across all Brouillon d'un reve categories. No application fee.

item.title: Stiftung Kunstfonds: KUNSTFONDS_Publikation 2027 (up to EUR 24,000)
item.description: Stiftung Kunstfonds · deadline 15 Jan 2027 · Up to EUR 24,000 per publication project; a minimum 10% own contribution is required and may come from third parties. No application fee.

item.title: Rhizome x Hartwig Art Foundation: Amsterdam City Fellow (two-year digital art research fellowship)
item.description: Rhizome, in partnership with Hartwig Art Foundation · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 per month stipend for a part-time commitment of roughly 2 days per week, over a two-year term (about EUR 28,800 total). Tickets to the Extreme Presence gathering provided. No application fee indicated.

item.title: Pedantic Arts Residency and Research Grant 2027 (Pittsburgh)
item.description: Pedantic Arts Residency · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Residency: free furnished housing in a shared apartment plus a USD 2,000 living stipend (half on arrival, half on completion). Research Grant: a free private bedroom at the Pedantic Apartment plus a USD 500 or USD 1,000 honorarium at the grantee's discretion. Application free until 28 September 2026, then USD 20.

item.title: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships 2027-2028 (Austin, Texas)
item.description: Harry Ransom Center, The University of Texas at Austin · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · Postdoctoral Fellowships: USD 3,500 per month for one or two months. Dissertation Fellowships: USD 2,500. Travel Stipends: USD 2,000 (open to graduate students, faculty and independent researchers including artists and journalists). International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.title: culture360 / ASEF: Call for Content, Arts in the Wake of AI
item.description: Asia-Europe Foundation (ASEF), culture360.ASEF.org · deadline 29 Sep 2026 · SGD 250 fee per commissioned article, podcast or video interview. Up to two proposals per application, of which at most one is selected. No application fee.

item.title: AI Philosophy Competition: First Edition
item.description: Zachary Goodsell and Elliott Thornley, funded by Forethought Research · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 3,000 first prize, USD 2,000 second, USD 1,000 third, plus a USD 5,000 pool for creative methodology distributed at the judges' discretion (USD 11,000 total). No entry fee.

item.title: Nieman Fellowships at Harvard, Class of 2028
item.description: Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 87,500 stipend paid over the nine-month academic year (2026-27 figure), plus additional allowances for housing, childcare and health insurance. Fellows audit courses across Harvard and participate in Nieman seminars, master classes and workshops. No application fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: Briarpatch Magazine: AI Resistance Issue, Winter 2027 Call for Pitches
item.description: Briarpatch Magazine · deadline 18 Sep 2026 · CAD 150 for profiles, short essays, book reviews and parting shots (under ~1,500 words); CAD 250 for feature stories and photo essays; CAD 350 for research-based articles and investigative reporting (2,000-2,500 words). No pitch fee.

item.title: Tech Policy Press Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Tech Policy Press · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend per fellow, paid quarterly. Also included: editorial guidance from the Tech Policy Press team, membership of an international cohort with regular feedback and exchange, and monthly sessions to strengthen the work. Fellows' work is published on the Tech Policy Press website and promoted through the newsletter, podcast and events. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new Writers grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • Tartu UNESCO City of Literature Residency for Writers and Translators, Autumn 2026
    https://tartu.kirjandus.ee/residency-autumn-2026
    Estonian Literary Society (Eesti Kirjanduse Selts), Focal Point for Tartu UNESCO City of Literature · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of EUR 600 for the two-month stay (EUR 1,200 in total), plus reimbursement of travel costs up to EUR 350. Free accommodation is provided in the Karl Ristikivi residency apartment, which has a bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom and exhibition room. One resident is selected. No application fee.
  • Numeric 2026: The Word (Les antipodes Research and Creation Residency)
    https://lesantipodes.com/numeric/2026_bases_en.html
    Les antipodes, with Bolit Centre d'Art Contemporani Girona and Museu de l'Emporda Figueres · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · Two grants. Each provides a stipend of EUR 1,000 as taxable base (taxes and withholdings apply), round-trip travel within the European Union, and accommodation and meals for the four weeks in Agullana. Travel and meals cover the resident only, though the shared apartment can host immediate family by arrangement. Numeric also provides the resources specified in the application and agreed during preparation. No application fee. Note that if a selected candidate lacks the professional registration needed to receive the stipend and payment has to be arranged through Les antipodes, the resulting costs are deducted from the stipend.
  • Rest of World: Labor x Tech Reporting Commissions (Year 3)
    https://restofworld.org/rest-of-worlds-labor-x-tech-reporting/
    Rest of World, underwritten by the Ford Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 1,000 per commissioned story of 800 to 1,000 words. No application fee.

item.title: 6 new Writers grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of Twente: Postdoc, Ethics and Epistemology of LLMs4EU (17 months)
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362444/postdoctoral-researcher-17-months-ethics-and-epistemology-of-llms4eu-design-data-and-deployment/
    University of Twente, Philosophy section / 4TU.Center for Ethics and Technology · deadline 25 Aug 2026 · EUR 4,241 to 5,538 gross per month (scale 10, steps 4 to 12) at 1.0 FTE, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and an 8.3 percent year-end bonus.
  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    https://arty-farty.typeform.com/to/xnDikGGM
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No submission fee.
  • Surel's Place: Month-Long Artist Residency (September 2026 deadline)
    https://surelsplace.org/month-long-residencies/
    Surel's Place · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Free rent, utilities and wi-fi, a living stipend of USD 100 per week, a USD 300 travel stipend, use of well-maintained bicycles, free or discounted tickets to art events and movies, marketing through Surel's Place channels, and event hosting including logistics and installation help. Each resident also gets a local host to orient them and host their public events. No application fee. NOTE: Surel's Place takes a commission on sales arising from the residency, 35% of retail price on artwork, 45% on ticketed events that are offsite or need contracted services (calculated after administrative expenses), and 15% on books, CDs or other merchandise tangential to the artist's medium. A surcharge may apply to cover additional utility costs if a partner joins.
  • Princeton Arts Fellowship 2027-2029 (Lewis Center for the Arts)
    https://apply.interfolio.com/187043
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 salary per year for each of two academic years, as a full-time 24-month appointment at the rank of Associate Professional Specialist. No application fee.
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.fondsbjp.nl/subsidies/
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
  • American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Writers grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• ProPublica Emerging Reporters Program 2026-2027
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/propublica/jobs/4577283006
    ProPublica · deadline 17 Aug 2026 · $9,000 stipend, paid as two instalments of $4,500 (one at the start of the programme, one at the midpoint), plus a fully funded journalism conference trip with accommodation and expenses covered. No application fee.
  • Trusted Creator Fellowship 2026 (News Creator Corps)
    https://newscreatorcorps.org/programs/trusted-creator/apply/
    News Creator Corps (a project of the Good Information Foundation) · deadline 17 Aug 2026 · $5,000 stipend on completing the programme. No application fee.
  • Sundance Institute: Episodic Program and Lab 2027
    https://filmfreeway.com/SundanceEpisodicLab2027
    Sundance Institute · deadline 25 Aug 2026 · No stipend or honorarium for participation. For the in-person Lab, Sundance covers round-trip basic economy airfare from the airport nearest the fellow's residence, shared housing with a private room and bath, and ground transport to and from the airport (fellows within 100 miles of the Lab get ground transport only). Meals, in-room charges, travel insurance, luggage fees and taxes are the fellow's own cost. One selected project also receives a separate monetary grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation for a series with an illuminating emphasis on science, including medicine, energy, technology or invention. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 nonrefundable processing fee per project submitted.

    https://theleonlevycenterforbiography.submittable.com/submit
    Leon Levy Center for Biography, CUNY Graduate Center · deadline 04 Jan 2027 · $72,000 stipend plus writing space, full research facilities and research assistance
